**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/realtor/property - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Realtor.com home by its link: the same Place and `place.ext.listing` as a search row, plus the description and the photo gallery. Realtor.com sends no price or tax history here, so `place.ext.listing.price_history` and `tax_history` are null.

**Use when** Use it with a Realtor.com home link when you need one home's description and photos.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - A Realtor.com home link under /realestateandhomes-detail/, for example https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-detail/14109-Willow-Tank-Dr_Austin_TX_78717_M78336-55435. · e.g. `https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-detail/14109-Willow-Tank-Dr_Austin_TX_78717_M78336-55435`

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude}; `place.ext` {listing}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.rating.max`, `place.rating.value`, `place.reviews_count`, `place.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/realtor/property" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-detail/14109-Willow-Tank-Dr_Austin_TX_78717_M78336-55435" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/realtor/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Realtor.com homes for sale or for rent from a Realtor.com search link (url): a city, ZIP code or neighborhood search under /realestateandhomes-search/, or a rental search under /apartments/, with any filters the link carries. Each home is a Place: `place.id` is the Realtor.com property id, `place.name` the street line, `place.address` the full address, with coordinates, the main photo and the listing link; `place.ext.listing` carries the price (the monthly rent on a rental), status (for_sale or for_rent), beds, baths, square feet, lot size, year built and home type. 40 homes a page by default, up to 200 with limit, with Realtor.com's total; pass the returned cursor for the next page. A home can appear on two consecutive pages, so de-duplicate on `place.id` when crawling.

**Use when** you want to list an area's homes from a Realtor.com search link, then page through with the cursor.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 40/page by default, max 200; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/40) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `url` (optional, string) - A Realtor.com search link, for example https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-search/Austin_TX or https://www.realtor.com/apartments/Austin_TX. · e.g. `https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-search/Austin_TX`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-200) - Homes a page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 40.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Constraints**

- `url` is required (it is optional in shape only - the request needs it).

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude}; `place.ext` {listing}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.rating.max`, `place.rating.value`, `place.reviews_count`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/realtor/search" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-search/Austin_TX" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
